остановиться.gloss: to stop, to come to a halt

meanings.en: to stop, to pause, to come to a halt
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to stop, to come to a halt', paired with 'останавливаться'.

examples.text: Он только начал бояться, а ты остановился!

examples.text: Ваня, ты что? Он только начал бояться, а ты остановился!
examples.trans: Vanya, what is wrong with you? He just started getting scared, and you stopped!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'what, that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Или тебя здесь что-то держит?
examples.trans: Or is something keeping you here?

examples.text: Что это за внеплановый семейный совет?
examples.trans: What is this unscheduled family council?

examples.text: Хорошо, что паспорт лежал в другом кармане.
examples.trans: It is a good thing my passport was in another pocket.

meanings.en: to do, to get up to (something outrageous)
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are doing, creating', paired with 'сотворить'.

examples.text: Костя, остановись, что ты творишь?
examples.trans: Kostya, stop, what are you doing?

examples.text: Самсоновы, вы что творите?
examples.trans: Samsonovs, what are you doing?

examples.text: Он сам не понимает, что творит.
examples.trans: He doesn't know what he is doing himself.
